description.zh: 把模型写在回答里的 dsh-ui 围栏渲染成可交互界面：58 种组件、图表与流程图、表单本地判分、常驻面板与导出，含空态、骨架、分栏、确认层与多屏原型。
description.en: Renders the model's dsh-ui fences as interactive UI: 58 components, charts and diagrams, local grading, a persistent panel dock and export, with empty/loading/split states, confirmation modals and multi-screen prototypes.
